title: Rifamycin as a named antibiotic class
dek: Ansamycin class node: rifampin, rifapentine, rifabutin. Individual drugs and rpoB stay on existing tb-* plates.
story: Rifamycin on Wikipedia is the ansamycin class that binds bacterial RNA polymerase. TB programmes meet it as rifampicin/rifampin, rifapentine, and rifabutin — already separate Simplfy drug plates.
This card exists so 'rifamycin' as a search word does not spawn a fourth dosing article. Class properties (CYP3A induction, orange fluids, RNAP target) are the glossary; doses are WHO.
Wikidata P2176 on Q12204 lists rifampicin among therapies. That is a class celebrity, not a complete Group A map.
deep: Rifabutin is the ART-interaction fork (tb-rifabutin, tb-hiv-art).
rpoB RRDR is shared class resistance logic (tb-rifampin).
Do not interchange members because Wikipedia groups them.

visual.caption: Class at the top, named TB members, then the rpoB plate all of them care about.
